entries.purpose: Calculate C3 net assimilation based on the Farquhar-von Caemmerer-Berry model.
entries.source_title: A biochemical model of photosynthetic CO2 assimilation in leaves of C3 species
entries.valid_domain: Valid leaf temperature; supplied biochemical parameters
assumptions: Mesophyll conductance is assumed infinite (Ci = Cc).
notes: Calibration parameters must be explicitly supplied.

entries.purpose: Calculate stomatal conductance based on net assimilation and VPD.
entries.equation_or_algorithm: g_sw = g0 + 1.6 * (1 + g1 / sqrt(D)) * An / Ca
entries.source_title: Reconciling the optimal and empirical approaches to modelling stomatal conductance
entries.valid_domain: Positive assimilation (or clamps to g0), positive VPD.
assumptions: Stomatal conductance to CO2 is g_sw / 1.6.
Boundary layer conductance is assumed infinite (Ca = Cs).
notes: Calculates stomatal conductance to water vapor, converted to CO2 conductance internally for coupling.

entries.purpose: Solve internal CO2 iteratively using FvCB and Medlyn models.
assumptions: Damped successive substitution provides stable convergence for Ci.
notes: Fails explicitly if convergence is not reached; no silent fallbacks.
